<p id="A3.SS6.p9.6" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS6.p9.6.1" class="ltx_text">where the last inequality follows from the definition of <math id="A3.SS6.p9.m15" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\widetilde{K}_{T}(k)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><msub><mover accent="true"><mi>K</mi><mo>~</mo></mover><mi>T</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>k</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\widetilde{K}_{T}(k)</annotation></semantics></math> and since <math id="A3.SS6.p9.m16" class="ltx_Math" alttext="|\mathcal{I}|+|\overline{\mathcal{I}}|=M" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℐ</mi><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow><mo>+</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mover accent="true"><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℐ</mi><mo stretchy="true">¯</mo></mover><mo stretchy="false">|</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>M</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">|\mathcal{I}|+|\overline{\mathcal{I}}|=M</annotation></semantics></math>. Since <math id="A3.SS6.p9.m17" class="ltx_Math" alttext="K_{T}(k)\leq 2\left(\mathcal{T}_{1}+\mathcal{T}_{2}\right)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>K</mi><mi>T</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>k</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>≤</mo><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mrow><msub><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒯</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>+</mo><msub><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">𝒯</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">K_{T}(k)\leq 2\left(\mathcal{T}_{1}+\mathcal{T}_{2}\right)</annotation></semantics></math>, we have shown that</span></p>

<td class="ltx_td ltx_align_right ltx_eqn_cell"><math id="A3.Ex83.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\displaystyle K_{T}(k)\leq 6\widetilde{K}_{T}(k)+96M\log\frac{4M}{\delta}," display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>K</mi><mi>T</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>k</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>≤</mo><mrow><mrow><mn>6</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><msub><mover accent="true"><mi>K</mi><mo>~</mo></mover><mi>T</mi></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>k</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mo>+</mo><mrow><mn>96</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>M</mi><mo lspace="0.167em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mi>log</mi><mo lspace="0.167em">⁡</mo><mstyle displaystyle="true"><mfrac><mrow><mn>4</mn><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>M</mi></mrow><mi>δ</mi></mfrac></mstyle></mrow></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo>,</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\displaystyle K_{T}(k)\leq 6\widetilde{K}_{T}(k)+96M\log\frac{4M}{\delta},</annotation></semantics></math></td>
<td class="ltx_eqn_cell ltx_eqn_center_padright"></td></tr></tbody>
</table>
<p id="A3.SS6.p9.7" class="ltx_p"><span id="A3.SS6.p9.7.1" class="ltx_text">with probability at least <math id="A3.SS6.p9.m18" class="ltx_Math" alttext="1-\delta" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>δ</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">1-\delta</annotation></semantics></math>. This completes the proof.
∎</span></p>

    <h2>Instructions for reporting errors</h2>
    <p>We are continuing to improve HTML versions of papers, and your feedback helps enhance accessibility and mobile
      support. To report errors in the HTML that will help us improve conversion and rendering, choose any of the
      methods listed below:</p>
    <ul>
      <li>Click the "Report Issue" <span class="mobile-only">(<svg role="presentation"
            style="display: inline-block; vertical-align: middle; fill: var(--text-color);" aria-hidden="true"
            height="1em" viewBox="0 0 640 640">

              d="M224 160C224 107 267 64 320 64C373 64 416 107 416 160L416 163.6C416 179.3 403.3 192 387.6 192L252.5 192C236.8 192 224.1 179.3 224.1 163.6L224.1 160zM569.6 172.8C580.2 186.9 577.3 207 563.2 217.6L465.4 290.9C470.7 299.8 474.7 309.6 477.2 320L576 320C593.7 320 608 334.3 608 352C608 369.7 593.7 384 576 384L480 384L480 416C480 418.6 479.9 421.3 479.8 423.9L563.2 486.4C577.3 497 580.2 517.1 569.6 531.2C559 545.3 538.9 548.2 524.8 537.6L461.7 490.3C438.5 534.5 395.2 566.5 344 574.2L344 344C344 330.7 333.3 320 320 320C306.7 320 296 330.7 296 344L296 574.2C244.8 566.5 201.5 534.5 178.3 490.3L115.2 537.6C101.1 548.2 81 545.3 70.4 531.2C59.8 517.1 62.7 497 76.8 486.4L160.2 423.9C160.1 421.3 160 418.7 160 416L160 384L64 384C46.3 384 32 369.7 32 352C32 334.3 46.3 320 64 320L162.8 320C165.3 309.6 169.3 299.8 174.6 290.9L76.8 217.6C62.7 207 59.8 186.9 70.4 172.8C81 158.7 101.1 155.8 115.2 166.4L224 248C236.3 242.9 249.8 240 264 240L376 240C390.2 240 403.7 242.8 416 248L524.8 166.4C538.9 155.8 559 158.7 569.6 172.8z" />
          </svg>)</span> button, located in the page header.</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong>Tip:</strong> You can select the relevant text first, to include it in your report.</p>
    <p>Our team has already identified <a class="ltx_ref" href="https://github.com/arXiv/html_feedback/issues"
        target="_blank">the following issues</a>. We appreciate your time reviewing and reporting rendering errors we
      may not have found yet. Your efforts will help us improve the HTML versions for all readers, because disability
      should not be a barrier to accessing research. Thank you for your continued support in championing open access for
      all.</p>
    <p>Have a free development cycle? Help support accessibility at arXiv! Our collaborators at LaTeXML maintain a <a
        class="ltx_ref" href="https://github.com/brucemiller/LaTeXML/wiki/Porting-LaTeX-packages-for-LaTeXML"
        target="_blank">list of packages that need conversion</a>, and welcome <a class="ltx_ref"
        href="https://github.com/brucemiller/LaTeXML/issues" target="_blank">developer contributions</a>.</p>
